dedupe_keys.name: a mediterranean coastal database for assessing the impacts of sea level rise and associated hazards

description: A Mediterranean coastal database for assessing the impacts of sea-level rise and associated hazards is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Claudia Wolff et al. We have developed a new coastal database for the Mediterranean basin that is intended for coastal impact and adaptation assessment to sea-level rise and associated hazards on a regional scale. The data structure of the database relies on a linear representation of the coast with associated spatial assessment units. Coverage: not stated; published in 2018. Formats: CSV, Shapefile. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
